_comment: EDIT THIS ON EVERY RELEASE. It is what tells an installed app that a newer build exists. Deploys with the website (Vercel), so no backend change is needed. latestVersionCode must match android/app/build.gradle's versionCode. Set minSupportedVersionCode ONLY when a build is genuinely unusable (a broken API contract, a data-loss bug) — it BLOCKS every older build from opening, so a typo here locks every tester out until you redeploy.
